candidates.purpose: Point-in-time SEC/EDGAR filing ingestion and structured catalyst extraction for Fresh Catalyst, Dilution/Financing and Event-Timing Context lanes
candidates.latencySuitability: MEDIUM-HIGH for filing/catalyst path; not a tick-data hot-path component
candidates.maintenance: Active; recent repository activity observed in August 2026
candidates.docsTests: Strong README/API examples; structured filing/company/XBRL access. Sandbox validation still required for TAGX-specific timing semantics.
securityNotes: Respect SEC fair-access/user-agent requirements and rate limits
Do not expose credentials or private identifiers in browser code
Pin/test dependency versions before any server-side integration
lookAheadBiasNotes: Persist original SEC accepted/filing timestamps and ingestion timestamp separately
Never train a T-minus replay on amended or later-parsed facts unless the fact was available at that historical timestamp
Treat XBRL revisions/amendments as new events rather than retroactively rewriting point-in-time state
candidates.dataCostRequirements: Public SEC EDGAR; network access and fair-access compliance required
benchmarkRequired: before/after Catalyst Attribution Error on multi-session sample
